note.en: The highest national death toll of the war; estimates commonly range from about 24 to 27 million.
note.zh: 全战争中死亡人数最高的国家；常见估计约为 2400 万至 2700 万。

source.title: Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II

note.en: Estimates vary very widely, from roughly 15 to 20 million dead, reflecting the difficulty of wartime records.
note.zh: 估计差异极大，约为 1500 万至 2000 万，反映战时记录的困难。

source.title: Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II

disputed: Chinese WWII deaths are estimated across a wide range (about 15–20 million) depending on how war-related famine and disease are counted.

note.en: Estimates range from about 6.9 to 7.4 million, including military and civilian dead.
note.zh: 估计约为 690 万至 740 万，含军人与平民。

source.title: Deutsche militärische Verluste im Zweiten Weltkrieg
source.author: Rüdiger Overmans

note.en: Overwhelmingly civilian deaths, including about 3 million Polish Jews murdered in the Holocaust.
note.zh: 绝大多数为平民死亡，包括约 300 万在大屠杀中遇害的波兰犹太人。

source.title: Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II

note.en: Estimates range from about 2.5 to 3.1 million military and civilian dead.
note.zh: 估计约为 250 万至 310 万军人与平民死亡。

source.title: Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II

note.en: Estimates range from about 1 to 1.7 million dead, including occupation, resistance, and internal conflict.
note.zh: 估计约为 100 万至 170 万死亡，含占领、抵抗与内部冲突。
